defeats.how: Magneto, having already beaten Mesmero and hijacked his plot, magnetically hurled him from the flying trailer down into the Andes.
defeats.evidence: he magnetically hurls Mesmero away to the Earth

defeats.how: Magneto overpowered the X-Men's scattered attacks one by one with his magnetic powers and force field, even turning Wolverine's claws against him.
defeats.evidence: The entire team has been taken out.
